meta.description: Hand-labelled gold set for retrieval evaluation of the normative RAG pipeline (recall@k, hit@k, MRR, nDCG). Each query is tagged with the article(s) that actually contain the answer, so a retrieved chunk counts as relevant when its (doc, article_ref) is in `relevant`.
meta.corpus: Turin national slice — 3 Italian national documents currently in the manifest
meta.match_on: doc_key + article_ref against each retrieved chunk's metadata. doc_key maps to metadata.doc_name via manifest.MANIFESTS['turin']; article_ref matches the chunker's normalised form ('Art. 1', 'Art. 23-ter', ...). article_ref '*' means doc-level: any chunk from that document counts (used for the DM 1256 annex, whose '§ 7.1'-style sections have no citable article numbers). Each '*' label is satisfied at most once so recall stays bounded.
caveats: Author-constructed, not domain-expert-validated — state this as a limitation. Kerem should sanity-check every `relevant` label before reporting numbers.

Most queries have a single relevant article, so precision@k is capped at 1/k and is NOT a meaningful headline metric here — lead with recall@k / hit@k / MRR. The multi-article query q14 (habitability height + area) is included so nDCG@k has a multi-relevant case to grade.

Queries are written in English on purpose, to test bge-m3's cross-lingual retrieval (EN query -> IT source). Two Italian queries (q08, q15) are included to compare same-language vs cross-language. Add more IT variants trivially by copying a row and changing `lang` + `query`.
Ground-truth values (`gold_value`) are for the qualitative showcase / manual spot-checks, not used by the metric computation.

queries.query: What is the minimum internal ceiling height for habitable rooms in a dwelling?
queries.gold_value: 2.70 m; reducible to 2.40 m for corridors, bathrooms and storage rooms

queries.query: Is a reduced ceiling height allowed in mountain municipalities above 1000 metres of altitude?
queries.gold_value: Yes — down to 2.55 m above 1000 m a.s.l.

queries.query: What is the minimum habitable floor area required per occupant?
queries.gold_value: 14 m² per person for the first 4 occupants, 10 m² for each additional occupant

queries.query: What is the minimum area of a single bedroom and of a double bedroom?
queries.gold_value: 9 m² single, 14 m² double

queries.query: What is the minimum size of the living room in a dwelling?
queries.gold_value: At least 14 m²

queries.query: What is the minimum floor area of a studio apartment for one person and for two people?
queries.gold_value: 28 m² for one person (services included), 38 m² for two

queries.query: What indoor air temperature must the heating system be designed to maintain?
queries.gold_value: Between 18 °C and 20 °C

queries.query: Qual è il rapporto minimo tra superficie finestrata e superficie del pavimento per l'illuminazione naturale?
queries.gold_value: Superficie finestrata apribile >= 1/8 della superficie del pavimento; fattore di luce diurna medio >= 2%

queries.query: What ventilation and sanitary fixtures are required for a bathroom?
queries.gold_value: External opening or mechanical extraction; at least one bathroom with toilet, bidet, bath/shower, washbasin

queries.query: What are the acoustic / noise-protection requirements for building materials in dwellings?
queries.gold_value: Adequate protection against footstep, traffic, plant and airborne noise from adjacent units

queries.query: Does converting a building to a different use (change of use) require authorisation, and when is it urbanistically relevant?
queries.gold_value: Change of use between different functional categories is urbanistically relevant (Art. 23-ter TUE)

queries.query: Which building interventions require a building permit (permesso di costruire)?
queries.gold_value: New construction, urban restructuring, and major changes as listed in Art. 10 TUE

queries.query: Which minor works qualify as free building activity that needs no permit?
queries.gold_value: Ordinary maintenance and the works listed under 'attività edilizia libera' (Art. 6 TUE)

queries.query: What are the overall minimum habitability requirements (height and floor area) for a residential unit?
queries.gold_value: Height 2.70 m (Art. 1) + 14 m²/person, bedrooms 9/14 m² (Art. 2)

queries.query: Quando è obbligatoria l'installazione dell'ascensore in un edificio residenziale?
queries.gold_value: Quando l'accesso alla più alta unità immobiliare è posto oltre una certa quota (criteri generali di accessibilità)

queries.query: What are the minimum door widths and ramp slopes for wheelchair accessibility?
queries.gold_value: Door clear width >= 0.80 m; ramp slope <= 8% (both in Art. 8 'Specifiche funzionali e dimensionali')

queries.query: In a university student residence, what is the minimum net floor area of a single room (posto letto)?
queries.gold_value: Single room >= 11 m² (DM 1256 Allegato A, section 7.1 Area Funzionale Residenza)
queries.note: STUDENT-HOUSING framing -> should resolve to DM 1256, NOT the general DM 1975 Art. 2. Doc-level match ('*') because the annex sections have no citable article numbers.

queries.query: What is the minimum area per resident for a double room in a student residence?
queries.gold_value: Double room >= 9.5 m² per resident (DM 1256 Allegato A)
queries.note: STUDENT-HOUSING framing. The general-vs-student split: contrast with q04 (generic 'bedroom' -> DM 1975 Art. 2, 9/14 m²).

queries.query: What is the minimum amount of public, green and community space per inhabitant required by urban planning standards?
queries.gold_value: ~18 m²/inhabitant of public space (DM 1444/1968, artt. 3-4)
queries.note: Exercises the added planning doc; doc-level match because the standard is split across artt. 3-4.

queries.query: How much parking space must be reserved for a new building?
queries.gold_value: 1 m² per 10 m³ of construction (Legge 122/1989 Art. 2, amending art. 41-sexies L.1150/1942)
